text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B and C after gains, but gains alone are not a reason to sell; I should weigh each position’s future risk and return rather than seek the satisfaction of locking in a profit.","I sold Stock A at a small gain, while doing nothing as the account fell in later periods. I should avoid judging each stock only against its purchase price and assess the portfolio as a whole.","Recent price moves do not predict future moves. I should make decisions from a consistent plan, not from short-term account changes or the pain of losses."]}
